title: Northstar synthetic plan: generic pharmacy copayment
source: CC0 synthetic training fixture; fictional policy statement
text: TRAINING FIXTURE — FICTIONAL POLICY. The Northstar sample prescription benefit assigns a 10 dollar copayment to a covered generic medicine filled at a participating in-network retail pharmacy for up to a 30-day supply. The dispensing pharmacy must confirm that the medicine is on the fictional sample formulary. A 90-day supply, specialty medicine, mail-order prescription, or brand medicine may use a different cost or approval rule; this document does not supply those rules. The sample statement does not recommend starting, stopping, or changing medication. A member should consult a qualified clinician about medical decisions. The plan assistant may summarize only the synthetic cost statement and must not invent formulary status for an unnamed medicine. This fixture contains no real drug list, patient record, pharmacy address, or clinical recommendation.
